name: ui-spec
title: UI spec cards
description: Attach a rich card to a task result with the `store-progress` input `uiSpec`: a json-render spec for the chat catalog that renders in the Slack outcome card, the session view and Chat SDK channels. Covers the 12 components and their props, when to make a card and when not to, the caps and their Slack reasons, the https rule, buttons, the lead rule for worker specs, and 2 complete examples.
